{{main page image/DYK|image=Kane Parsons.jpg|caption=Kane Parsons}}<!--See [[Template:Main page image/DYK]] for other parameters-->
* ... that '''[[Kane Parsons]]'''  ''(pictured)'' became the youngest director to have a film open at the top of the North American box office?
* ... that [[Robert Moses]] defended the site of '''[[L/CPL Thomas P. Noonan Jr. Playground|a planned playground]]''' after local civic workers complained that the location was too rocky?
* ... that the songs on '''''[[The 20/20 Experience]]''''' use different metaphors for sex, including drugs, candy, and outer space?
* ... that historian '''[[Laura F. Edwards]]''' attended a music school that she said "actually diverted [her] away from music"?
* ... that '''[[Paradise Island Adventure Golf|a miniature golf chain]]''' is an affiliate member of both England and Scotland's national governing bodies for golf?
* ... that Kenyan coder '''[[Rose Njeri]]''' was arrested for creating a tool to help citizens voice their opposition to a change in tax laws?
* ... that '''[[Manuscript Hamilton 254|Manuscript Hamilton 254]]''' contains the oldest known extant drawing of the Parthenon?
* ... that Jamaican runner '''[[Janielle Josephs]]''' took up athletics in part because she "wanted to miss school"?
* ... that the police officer and the young boy who modeled for '''[[The Runaway (painting)|one of Norman Rockwell's most famous paintings]]''' became lifelong friends?
